behavior: The skill exists as a record with valid frontmatter and renders for every agent
It never merges and never applies without confirmation
verification: grep -q 'Never merge' harness/skills/pr-review-triage/SKILL.md && grep -q 'wait for confirmation before applying anything' harness/skills/pr-review-triage/SKILL.md

behavior: It distinguishes a review that found nothing from a review that never ran
verification: grep -q 'Never ran' harness/skills/pr-review-triage/SKILL.md && grep -q 'without.*claiming review coverage you do not have' harness/skills/pr-review-triage/SKILL.md

behavior: It exits in one line when there is nothing to dispose of
verification: grep -q 'Stop here when there is nothing to dispose of' harness/skills/pr-review-triage/SKILL.md

behavior: It names no review vendor: dispositions depend on the claim, not the author
It is universal: no targets[] fence, since it uses only gh and shell
